meaning: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
usage: 常见不规则动词：go-went, eat-ate, see-saw, take-took, come-came。
examples: I went to London last year.
mistakes: 不规则动词按规则加 -ed
did 后动词仍用过去式
compare: 不规则 vs. 规则：只能死记，无统一规律。

usage: am/is/are going to + 动词原形。用于计划、意图或明显迹象。
examples: I am going to study medicine.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
She is going to call you later.
mistakes: to 后加 -ing（*going to studying*）
漏掉 be 动词
compare: be going to vs. will：going to 表已有计划/迹象，will 表即时决定或预测。

usage: will + 动词原形。表即时决定、预测、承诺、请求。
examples: I think it will rain tomorrow.
mistakes: will 后加 to（*I will to go*）
will 后动词加 -s
compare: will vs. going to：will 更临时/主观，going to 更计划/依据。

usage: have/has + 过去分词。表经历、已完成且与现在有关的动作。
examples: Have you ever been to Japan?
mistakes: 过去分词用错（*I have went*）
与过去时间状语连用（*I have seen him yesterday*）
compare: 现在完成时 vs. 一般过去时：是否强调与现在的联系。

usage: -er / more + adj + than。短形容词加 -er，长形容词用 more。
examples: This book is more interesting than that one.
mistakes: 双写规则错误（*biger*）
more 与 -er 同时用（*more taller*）
compare: 比较级 vs. 最高级：两者比较用 -er/more，三者及以上用 -est/most。

usage: -est / most + adj + the。短形容词加 -est，长形容词用 most。
examples: He is the tallest in the class.
This is the most expensive restaurant.
It was the best day of my life.
mistakes: 漏掉 the
最高级后仍用 than（应用 in/of）
compare: 最高级常与 in + 群体 / of + 范围连用。

usage: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never。位置：be 后、实义动词前。
mistakes: 频率副词放错位置（*I drink always coffee*）
在句末误用 always
compare: always 与 usually 频率强弱：always 100%，usually 约80%。

usage: some 用于肯定；any 用于否定/疑问；no 相当于 not any。
mistakes: 否定句用 some（*I don't have some money*）
any 用于肯定但表任何
compare: some vs. any：基本按肯定/否定/疑问划分。

usage: much + 不可数，many + 可数，a lot of/lots of 两者皆可。
examples: There are a lot of books.
mistakes: many 修饰不可数
疑问句用 much 但表可数
compare: much/many 多用于否定/疑问，a lot of 多用于肯定。

usage: should + 动词原形。表建议、义务、预期。
examples: She shouldn't eat so much sugar.
mistakes: should 后加 to
should 后加 -ing
compare: should vs. must：should 表建议，must 表强制。

usage: Would you like...? / I'd like... 表礼貌请求或意愿。
examples: I'd like a cup of coffee.
She would like to visit China.
mistakes: I would like + 动词原形（*I'd like go* 应为 I'd like to go）
Would like 与 like 混淆
compare: would like 更礼貌、一次性，like 表爱好、习惯。

usage: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。表动作回到主语自身。
mistakes: 人称与反身代词不一致（*He hurt herself*）
主语非动作对象时滥用反身代词
compare: each other 表互相，反身代词表自身。

usage: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs。单独使用，代替名词短语。
mistakes: 名词性物主代词后加名词（*yours book*）
与形容词性物主代词混淆
compare: your + 名词 vs. yours（单独）。

usage: me, you, him, her, it, us, them。用于动词或介词后。
mistakes: 用主格代替宾格（*She saw I*）
介词后用主格
compare: 主格 vs. 宾格：主格作主语，宾格作宾语。

mistakes: enough 位置错误（*enough tall*）
too 与 very 混淆（too 含负面含义）
compare: too + 形容词（过头） vs. enough（足够）。
